VI.description: Headless DQMH Remove Event. Removes ONE event from ONE DQMH module in the ACTIVE project by calling Delacor's own scripting VIs as STATIC subVIs - the chain Delacor's Event\5CRemove DQMH Event.vi runs behind its dialog\2C with no dialog and no keystroke.\0A\0AChain\3A lvdqmh_pick_event.vi (parse\2C pick module and event by NAME\2C close the other modules) -> Check for Dependent Broadcast.vi -> Open Main and Tester References.vi -> Remove Event.vi for the broadcast half of a Round Trip first\2C then Remove Event.vi for the event itself -> lvdqmh_close_modules.vi.\0A\0AAS DELACOR WIRES IT. Check for Dependent Broadcast.vi takes the EVENT index on its Selected Module input. The broadcast half is removed WITHOUT the Main VI reference and the event itself WITH it\2C and both calls get the event list read before either removal. The Main\2C tester and RT tester references are closed afterwards with their errors dropped\2C as Delacor's dialog does. Merged\2C they answered Error 1026 after a removal that had succeeded\2C on a module with no RT tester.\0A\0AWHY ONE HIERARCHY. Module Info carries thirteen refnums that LabVIEW releases when the top-level VI that opened them stops\2C so the parse and the scripter must run under one top-level VI.\0A\0ADRY RUN BY DEFAULT. Script? FALSE parses and reports only. Scripting also needs the module and the event found\2C no locked and no unsaved module - Delacor's remove dialog refuses unsaved modules too - and no error. Dependent Broadcast? and Dependent Broadcast Name say what a Round Trip request would take with it\3B the name is empty unless the flag is TRUE\2C because Check for Dependent Broadcast.vi returns a broadcast name for ANY event. Not found is not an error\3A Module Index or Event Index -1. Scripted? says whether Remove Event.vi was called.\0A\0ANO MODAL DIALOG ON PURPOSE. Delacor's dialog warns with a modal and opens the Error List window\3B neither is done here\2C and Remove Event.vi is never handed an incoming error. Main and tester panels are NOT opened afterwards\2C where Delacor's dialog opens them.\0A\0ARequires DQMH installed\2C a project OPEN AND ACTIVE in the IDE\2C and lvdqmh_pick_event.vi and lvdqmh_close_modules.vi loaded. Generated by LabVIEWMCP\3B the Delacor VIs it calls belong to the user's DQMH installation and are not shipped with it.
